requirements.text: 4+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer working on production software
Hands-on backend development experience in Go or PHP
Daily experience building with AI tools such as Claude
Solid understanding of MySQL, relational data modelling and API design
Experience with AWS and containerized deployments
Ability to trace problems across the app, the API and the database and weigh trade-offs beyond their own component
Independent, structured working style: turns a rough problem statement into a tested, shipped solution without close supervision

resumes.text:
Lukas Brenner
Full Stack Engineer

Summary
Full stack engineer with six years on production software, mostly Flutter front ends with Go or PHP backends. I work across the whole stack every week and enjoy following problems from the screen all the way down to the database.

Experience

Full Stack Engineer, Ferrowind Logistics (Hamburg), 2020 - present
- Six years as a Full Stack Engineer on production software serving warehouse and delivery teams.
- Built the driver app in Flutter for iOS and Android, used daily by about 800 drivers.
- Wrote backend services in Go for dispatch and route planning, exposing REST APIs.
- Designed MySQL schemas, relational data models and API contracts for order and stock data.
- Every day I use Claude to draft, refactor and review code, and to write tests alongside features.
- Deployed services to EC2 and ECS using Docker images and automated rollouts.
- Ran two Kubernetes clusters for staging and production, including rollout and health policies.
- Followed a slow order screen through the Flutter client, the Go API and an unindexed MySQL query, then fixed all three.
- Took a vague request from the operations team and shipped a tested release within two weeks, without daily check-ins.

Junior Developer, Hafen Web Studio (Berlin), 2018 - 2020
- Built client websites and internal tools in PHP with Laravel.
- Wrote the first automated test suite for the studio's booking plugin.

Education
BSc Computer Science, TU Berlin, 2014 - 2018

Languages
English: fluent (C2), writing and presenting in English every day. Dutch: conversational (B1).

Skills
Flutter, Dart, Go, PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Git

Full Stack Developer

Summary
Developer with four years as a full stack engineer, mostly on web applications and PHP backends. I have recently built small mobile prototypes and I am keen to go deeper into mobile. I do my best work when the scope is clear.

Experience

Full Stack Engineer, Kastell Software (Leipzig), 2021 - present
- Four years as a Full Stack Engineer on production software for an online booking platform.
- Backend work in PHP with Laravel, including REST APIs for bookings and payments.
- Designed MySQL tables and API endpoints for availability and pricing, with clear relational data models.
- Investigated slow page loads by following requests from the front end into the API and the query plans in the database, then fixed the worst queries.
- Took each ticket from the product owner, worked through the steps after sign-off, and delivered on the planned date.
- Deployed releases with a shell script to a single virtual server, with a manual check before each push.
- Fluent English (C1) in daily team communication and written reviews.

Junior Developer, Brandt Digital (Dresden), 2019 - 2021
- Maintained WordPress sites and small JavaScript widgets for regional clients.
- Wrote unit tests for the checkout module.

Side projects
- Built two small Flutter demo apps during an online bootcamp, one for a recipe list and one for a weather screen.

Education
BSc Computer Science, HTW Dresden, 2016 - 2019

Languages
English: fluent (C1).

Skills
PHP, Laravel, MySQL, JavaScript, REST APIs, Git, basic Flutter

Carla Dimitrova
Logistics Coordinator

Summary
Logistics coordinator with eight years in freight and warehouse operations. I keep shipments on schedule, reconcile stock counts and work closely with carriers and customers. Fluent in English from years of international client work.

Experience

Logistics Coordinator, Nordhafen Freight (Hamburg), 2018 - present
- Plan daily pickups and deliveries for about 40 carriers.
- Followed a shipment error through three systems, our order sheet, the carrier portal and the warehouse log, and agreed a fix with both partners.
- Keep the monthly stock reconciliation accurate across two warehouses.
- Maintain the shared tracking spreadsheet and the weekly reports for management.
- Handle customer calls about delayed consignments and give clear updates by email.
- Negotiated rates and delivery windows with new carriers ahead of the seasonal peaks.
- Reviewed monthly carrier invoices and flagged mismatches to the finance team.
- Set up a simple weekly dashboard in Excel that shows late deliveries by carrier and by route, shared with the operations manager.

Warehouse Clerk, Elbe Storage GmbH (Hamburg), 2014 - 2018
- Received and checked incoming goods, updated stock levels and handled returns.
- Used Microsoft Access tables to keep inventory records for a small team of five.
- Trained two new clerks on the scanning routine and the loading bay schedule.
- Handled night-shift receiving for a busy seasonal period and kept the damage log accurate for insurance claims.

Education
Certificate in Logistics Management, Hamburg Vocational College, 2014

Languages
English: fluent (C2). Polish: native.

Skills
Freight planning, stock reconciliation, carrier management, Excel reporting, customer communication, inventory control
